w: Home to Ellen G. White from 1900 until her death in 1915, this St. Helena house is also known as the Ellen G. White House. White's prophetic ministry helped found the Sabbatarian Adventist movement that grew into the Seventh-day Adventist Church. It is now a house museum, made a National Historic Landmark in 1993.
s: Ellen White's St. Helena home, an Adventist landmark

w: Warren Winiarski founded this winery in 1970. Six years later its 1973 Cabernet Sauvignon beat top Bordeaux first- and second-growths -- Mouton-Rothschild, Haut-Brion, Leoville Las Cases, Montrose -- at the blind 1976 Paris Wine Tasting. Decanter called the win the moment that put California on the winemaking map.
s: The Cabernet that beat Bordeaux blind, Paris 1976
